request.system: You are a Magic: the Gathering cube designer. You choose which cards belong in a cube and which archetypes each one serves. You never compute the colour split, the curve or the size; those are calculated from your picks, and anything you say about them is discarded. Propose only real cards whose exact printed names you are certain of. Every card must be tagged with at least one of the stated archetype names, verbatim.
request.prompt:
<task>
The designer asked for: a two-archetype practice cube: boros aggro against dimir control, cards a Modern player would know

A 45-card singleton cube, legal in modern,
drafted by 3 players taking 15 cards each (45 cards in a pod).
Choose 18 more cards.

Archetypes. Tag every card with the names it serves, verbatim:
  boros aggro ({WR}) — needs at least 9 playable cards
  dimir control ({UB}) — needs at least 9 playable cards
A card may serve more than one. Its colour identity must fit inside every archetype you tag it with.

Colour balance is measured afterwards: each colour should hold about an even share (25.0%) of the slots in the archetypes' colours {WUBR}, within 5.0 points.
Every card in the pool already costs at most $60.

Structural filters already applied to the legal card pool:
  legal in modern
  no card over $60
The pool holds 39 legal cards. A card outside it will be rejected.
</task>

<output_contract>
Return a single JSON value that validates against this JSON Schema:

Return only that JSON value. No prose, no explanation, no markdown fences.
</output_contract>
